description: Fisheries Management Committee  - Notified that Thalan Lagoon, Madampa, Koggala and Garaduwa Fisheries Management Committee has been established & registered
categorisation: This gazette contains notifications made by the Director General of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 02 of 1996, specifically establishing and registering Fisheries Management Committees. This constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
